title: DAY 6 — LESSON 3: HELPING COLLEAGUES WITHOUT NEGLECTING PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

questions.prompt: What is the best description of healthy teamwork?
options: Completing everyone's duties regardless of your own workload
Supporting colleagues appropriately while remaining accountable for your own responsibilities
Refusing to help colleagues under any circumstances

questions.prompt: A therapist has an imminent appointment, and a colleague asks for non-urgent help. What should she normally do?
options: Complete essential appointment preparation before offering help

questions.prompt: What is a good way to help a new employee learn a procedure?
options: Always complete the task for her
Tell her to work it out alone
Explain, demonstrate and allow her to practise

questions.prompt: When should an employee seek supervisory guidance?
options: When competing responsibilities cannot be managed appropriately or require reassignment

questions.prompt: What does the HELP method stand for?
